observations: Four photos show a cream/white 4-thread overlock (serger) machine on a dark table.
Spool holders labeled LEFT NEEDLE, RIGHT NEEDLE, UPPER LOOPER, LOWER LOOPER are visible in photos 1 and 2.
A clear nameplate in photo 3 reads 'Frister+Rossmann Couturier H.D. MK II'.
Same nameplate is partly visible in photos 1 and 2.
Visible yellowing/discoloration on the plastic housing, especially the handwheel cover and base in photos 0-2.
No power cord, foot pedal, plug, or stand is visible in any photo.
No photo or clip shows the machine threaded, powered on, or stitching.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'NEWMEQ DIGITAL CONCEPTS' overlay the images; location tag 'Moniya, Nigeria' and date '2026/08/10' are burned into the photos.

claims.evidence: No photo shows it threaded and stitching fabric, no power cord or pedal visible to confirm it can even be powered on.

MK II 4-thread overlock machine, but no photo or video confirms it powers on or stitches, and key accessories are not shown, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested, accessory-incomplete unit.
